name: Default
description: State machine: every state plays an animation and lists conditions that move the controller into other states. Used when no "type" is given.

fields.description: An animation ID, a #key from the animations map, or a list of either.
Animations used instead while the player is in first person. Their bones are applied to the first-person arm. If empty, the first-person arm isn't animated.
Choose randomly, in sequence, or by a zero-based index. The index can be a dynamic value or MoLang expression.
Time spent blending into this state's animation.
Same as blend_transition, but used while a first-person animation is playing.
Destination state names mapped to the conditions that trigger each transition.
States of this controller, keyed by name. Transitions are evaluated in order every tick.
Another animation controller of the same type to inherit from. Own values override the parent's.
Named animation shortcuts, referenced as "#name". A list picks a random entry each time.
Ticks to blend when switching animations. 0 switches instantly.
Ticks to blend when switching animations while a first-person animation is playing. If not set, blend_transition is used.

name: Triggered
description: Plays one-shot animations when a condition becomes true. Each trigger plays its animation once, then waits until its condition is false again before it can fire again. No states or transitions needed.

fields.description: Animations to play, keyed by animation ID or "#key" reference, with the condition that triggers them. Earlier entries win when several conditions are true at once.
Another animation controller of the same type to inherit from. Own values override the parent's.
Named animation shortcuts, referenced as "#name". A list picks a random entry each time.
Ticks to blend when switching animations. 0 switches instantly.
Ticks to blend when switching animations while a first-person animation is playing. If not set, blend_transition is used.
